mrrp! is that a bug or a toy
new thing, you are very small
sniff sniff, you smell like dust
my paws want to touch it so bad
does it purr? i hope it purrs
it is round and it is looking at me
i hide behind the plant, then peek
nya, you are not my brother
i creep closer, one step at a time
tail low, ears up, ready for anything
it has a shadow. everything has a shadow
i bat at it with my left paw
no reaction. try the right paw
maybe it is sleeping like me
i will guard it while it sleeps
what if it is a tiny cloud that fell
i lick it once. tastes like nothing
the red dot brought me here maybe
i do not remember this from before
my whiskers are all tingly
is it a pebble? pebbles do not move
mrrp mrrp, are you lost little thing
i sit on it. now it is mine
it is under my butt. still there?
i roll over to show my belly
look how harmless i am, come play
i chase my tail near it to impress
it did not clap. rude
fine, i will love it anyway
i bring it a leaf as a gift
the leaf is bigger than it
i pat pat pat with both front paws
oh no, did i break it
it is okay, it is okay, still here
i curl around it like a nest
warmth comes from me not it
that is okay, i am warm enough
i yawn and it does not yawn back
maybe it is shy like the vacuum
i will be patient. i am good at napping
one eye open, one eye closed
watching you, new thing, always watching
the sun moved and you look different
i like you better in the light
my tummy rumbles. are you food?
i sniff your top, your side, your bottom
you do not run. i respect that
i would run if i were you
but i am glad you stay
mrrp, this is my favorite mystery
i will tell my sister about you
she will not believe my whiskers
i saw it twitch, i swear i did
my whole body is one big question
i do not know what you are
but i know i want to nap on you
later. first, more staring
you are so little and so still
i am little too. we match
